<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Gyazo - Not Found</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Gyazo - Page Not Found" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="Oops, we couldn't find this page." />
  <meta property="og:image" content="//assets2.gyazo.com/assets/images/error/404-5593f3bbe1.gif" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.1/css/bootstrap.min.css" media="all" charset="utf-8">

  <style media="all">
    body.error .caution {
      min-height: 325px;
      background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,");
      background-position: right bottom;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
    }

    body.error .caution .logo {
      width: 129px;
      height: 38px;
    }

    body.error .caution p.desc {
      color: #999;
      font-size: 24px;
      margin-top: 80px;
    }
    body.error .caution p,ul {
      color: #999;
      font-size: 18px;
      margin-top: 0;
      line-height: 150%;
      width: 350px;
    }
    .footer {
      margin:30px auto;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:12px;
      color:#777;
    }

    .footer a {
      color:#777;
    }
    .caution {
      font-size:108%;
      border:1px solid #eee;
      background:white;
      margin-top:40px;
      min-height:180px;
      padding:50px 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
    }

    .caution h2 {
      margin-top:0px;
    }

    .ninja-kun {
      display: block;
      margin: 60px auto 0 auto;
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 96%;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="error">
    <img src="//assets2.gyazo.com/assets/images/error/404-5593f3bbe1.gif"
         class="ninja-kun"
         alt="Gyazo">

  <div class="footer">
      <div class="container">
        <a href="/">Home</a> /
        <a href="https://helpfeel.com/Gyazo/">Help</a> /
        © <a href="https://corp.helpfeel.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Helpfeel Inc.</a>
      </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
